noise_contract.native_Gaussian: exogenous; retained in source receipts, never a steering target

metadata.logical_boundary: source PPO first-success prefix retained separately
metadata.physical_boundary: actual native physical_done; full physical episodes for history
metadata.physical_suffix: actual post-success controls included; no reward is moved or invented
metadata.streams: same task/declared collection slot across scheduled versions; source scenes may change
metadata.validation: held-out offline value/policy objective; source PPO saw all source states

value_contract.rewards: observed first-success once; physical suffix retained
value_contract.next_observation: next row within the same physical episode; terminal bootstrap zero
value_contract.targets: executed steering actions; no final-teacher relabels
value_contract.returns: complete observed episode, before sampling windows; critic supervision only
